title: Workspaces
summary: Keep each project folder's sessions, local agents and context together.

workflows.label: Start a project session
workflows.summary: Choose the project folder before choosing an agent and beginning a session.

entry.prerequisite: Session Options is the sliders button beside + at the top of the sidebar.

steps.action: In the Web UI, select the workspace folder from the sidebar workspace picker or New Session.
Choose an available agent for that workspace.
Start the session and check that its workspace label matches the project you selected.
From a terminal instead, change into the project folder and launch Kollab with cd ./project && kollab.

commands.description: Start Kollab from the selected project directory; its current folder is the workspace.
commands.expect: The session uses that folder for project-local context and agents.

media.alt: Kollab workspace picker showing project folders
media.caption: Select the project folder before opening a session so its context stays together.

workflows.success: The session runs in the chosen project workspace, keeping local agents and conversation history separate from other folders.

recovery.action: End or leave that session and choose the correct folder in the workspace picker before starting again.

recovery.symptom: A workspace's local agent is not listed
recovery.action: Check that the agent definition is in that workspace's .kollab/agents/ directory and refresh the agent list.

workflows.note: Reordering an agent row changes its position within its workspace, not its identity. Hiding a row does not delete or stop the agent.

workflows.label: Launch a team in a workspace
workflows.summary: Set the folder before launching a team so its members share the intended project context.

steps.action: In Agents → Teams, choose Configure & Launch for the team.
Set the workspace, profile, members, lead and mission, then review the reporting tree.
Launch after confirming the team and workspace are correct.

commands.description: Launch a team from a terminal in the chosen workspace.
commands.expect: The selected team's agents start with the workspace as their project directory.

workflows.success: The selected team's members start against the configured workspace and reporting structure.

recovery.symptom: A team member is missing or the wrong lead is selected
recovery.action: Reopen Configure & Launch, correct the member and lead selection, and review the effective reporting tree before launching.

workflows.label: Organize sidebar agents
workflows.summary: Reorder an agent within its workspace or hide it without stopping or deleting it.

steps.action: To reorder with a keyboard, focus the agent row, press Space to pick it up, use the arrow keys, then press Space to drop; press Escape to cancel.
To hide an agent, drag its row outside the sidebar and release when Release to hide appears, or choose Hide Agent from its actions menu.
Restore a hidden agent from Hidden Agents in the sidebar.

media.alt: Kollab sidebar showing workspace agent ordering and hidden agents
media.caption: Reorder within a workspace or hide a row; neither action stops the agent.

workflows.success: The agent appears in the new order or under Hidden Agents; it remains available and running as before.

recovery.symptom: A keyboard reorder did not take effect
recovery.action: Press Escape to cancel any active drag, then repeat Space, arrow keys and Space to drop.
Open Hidden Agents and restore the row; hiding never deletes or stops the agent.
